purpose: Separate errors where no current member predicted the correct class from errors where voting overrode at least one correct member. Use the two already completed group-disjoint fivefold assignments and the frozen vote nominated before them.
tabulation: For each assignment compute the protected incumbent and complementary member's four correctness combinations, the current combined correctness, all four actual members' individual correctness and uniquely correct counts, and how many currently wrong rows at least one member gets right. Across assignments count repeated errors, repeated unanimous errors, the same exclusively correct member, and whether the two aggregate choices continue to disagree in the same way. Verify the source fits, fold membership, recorded combined score for every fold and exhaustive error accounting.
boundary: Descriptive, label-informed ceiling on this known training corpus. The counts must not be supplied as per-row oracle choices or used to train or score a router on the same labels. No per-row examples or predictions published. No fits, model API, course designated validation, test or H2.
